caveat: The 38 priority nodes were semantically reviewed at the taxonomy level; the 306 others received conservative provisional triage. No historical link or entity identity certified; 210 original class omissions remain present in source unchanged. Never use this proposal for unattended migration.

ontology_macrotypes.teatro_danza: Tipologie, pratiche e generi scenici, balletto, musical
ontology_macrotypes.istituzione_ambiente: Cappelle, conservatori, accademie, luoghi istituzionali o ambienti di produzione
ontology_macrotypes.raccolta_documento: Raccolte, codici, antologie, edizioni e trattati
ontology_macrotypes.opera_specifica: Opera o composizione individualmente designata (ipotesi da verificare)
ontology_macrotypes.evento_produzione: Evento, esecuzione, edizione scenica, serie di concerti
ontology_macrotypes.caso_studio_ibrido: Caso che rinvia a più entità storiche senza identificarle
ontology_macrotypes.valutazione_manuale: Etichetta insufficiente o ambigua per classificazione affidabile

hard_rules: Do not map all legacy corrente nodes to Atlantis nodo-di-senso; specific works, editorial cases and institutions are different ontological kinds.
Preserve source taxonomy, raw payload, record order, incident record pointers, direction, provenance, notes and evidence in original files.
Only evidence-checked links can produce author-genre or author-work associations; exact label is candidate only.
No automatic identity merge, edge union, traversability through genre, period, geography, institution or editorial chapter.
Node/case/genre labels are not themselves a proof of attribution or historical connection.
Period and country contexts are terminal by default when non-root; chapters and media remain nontraversable.
Do not infer genre attribution from lexical matches in biographies.
